paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Ridge Career & Technology Center has been selected for a 2026–27 STEM classroom award. The center is the only recipient listed under Pontotoc Electric Power Association in the Tennessee Valley Authority’s new roster.

The list includes 36 Mississippi entries among 334 across the region. It names the schools and the local power companies that serve them. For Pontotoc Ridge, it gives neither a dollar amount nor a description of the project.

The program funds classroom and school projects in science, technology, engineering and math. Schools could request one of five amounts, from $1,000 to $5,000, according to the Tennessee STEM Innovation Network. TVA sponsors the program with Bicentennial Volunteers Inc., an organization of TVA retirees.

Pontotoc High School uses the center to introduce freshmen to technical careers. In March 2025, the school reported that students toured the center as they considered courses for later in high school. Instructors showed them robotics, information technology, welding and mechanics, among other career pathways.
